justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: MS-specific rehab (fatigue management, aquatic, exercise) shows meaningful functional gains; certification vs non-certification comparison absent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: MSCS exam plus experience requirements; moderate cost; annual CE required.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to clinicians in MS specialty programs or neuro practices with significant MS caseload.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: MS rehab billed under standard PT/OT codes; MSCS supports specialty MS clinic billing and program recognition in some health systems.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Valued in MS specialty clinics and neuro rehab programs; limited demand outside these settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: MS patients value clinicians who understand disease trajectory and variability.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: MS patients are typically insurance-covered with chronic, complex needs; out-of-pocket spend on a niche specialist is rare.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Low consumer awareness of the credential limits ability to charge premium rates above standard neuro PT.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Genuinely rare credential; few clinicians hold it, so it differentiates within neuro niches.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Hard to scale a practice around MS care; patient volume is limited and reimbursement-bound.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't search for 'MSCS'; they search for neurologists and MS centers.
justifications.business.efficiency: Moderate cost and exam-based; reasonable time investment relative to specialty depth.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized specialty credential signaling neuro expertise, useful for neuro faculty hires though not as weighty as NCS.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Holders often publish in MS rehab; modest but real scholarly footprint.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Adds depth to neuro curriculum modules on progressive disease and disability management.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: MS rehab literature is solid with multiple RCTs on exercise and fatigue management.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely listed as preferred in job postings; NCS is far more commonly cited.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheaper and faster than a neuro residency; reasonable path to documented specialty.
